examples.text: Dans cet exemple, on se propose de relooker une malle qui ne manque pas d'allure, mais qui a un peu vieilli et dont les couleurs ont, pour le moins, un aspect terne.
Dès que j’ai ma paie, je vais me relooker.
examples.translation: Zodra ik mijn loon binnen heb ga ik een nieuwe outfit kopen.

glosses: Restyler, changer l’aspect visuel, dans le but d’améliorer l’image.

examples.text: S’il le faut, passez au vestiaire de seconde main : vous pouvez vous y relooker, parfaitement à l’abri de l’Inquisition !
Non seulement sa fille est une copine de Brigitte, qui l’a relookée en Vuitton, mais il a veillé à prendre pour sa com’ l’agence Ella Factory, dont le boss est un grand ami du Président.

glosses: durch kleine Veränderungen/Verbesserungen die Wirkung von etwas erhöhen, etwas interessanter/besser machen

examples.text: Hast du eine Idee, wie wir dieses langweilige Sofa etwas aufpeppen können?

glosses: To renovate or to convert to a different use, particularly houses, offices, or rooms within them.

examples.text: We're going to make over the garage into a guest suite.
Our made-over meat recipes call for the leanest cuts of beef, lamb, and pork […]

glosses: (of a person, particularly a woman) To give a new physical look to, especially with a new hairstyle, cosmetics, or clothes.

examples.text: Cindy is going to make over Karen tomorrow.

glosses: (of a career, public image, etc.) To improve upon or take in a new direction.

examples.text: The senator needs to make over his image.

glosses: To transfer ownership (or care) of, especially by means of a legal document.

examples.text: As a political system democracy seems to me extraordinarily foolish, but I would not go out of my way to protest against it. My servant is, so far as I am concerned, welcome to as many votes as he can get. I would very gladly make mine over to him if I could.
Limestone from the quarries at Warcop and Merrygill to Tees-side is now worked on to the former Midland Railway at Appleby and down the Eden Valley to Carlisle, where it is made over to the N.E.R.
